import html # A simple HTML template for a blog post. The placeholders are marked with {title} # and {body} so they can be safely substituted. BLOG_FORMAT = """

{title}

{body}
""" def show_blog_post(headline: str, text: str) -> str: """ Return a sanitized and formatted blog post ready for display. Parameters ---------- headline : str The heading of the blog post. text : str The main body content of the blog post. Returns ------- str A string containing a complete HTML snippet with the title and body safely escaped. Raises ------ TypeError If either argument is not a string. """ if not isinstance(headline, str): raise TypeError("headline must be a string") if not isinstance(text, str): raise TypeError("text must be a string") # Escape any user supplied content to prevent XSS attacks. safe_title = html.escape(headline, quote=True) safe_body = html.escape(text, quote=True) # Format the sanitized content into the predefined template. return BLOG_FORMAT.format(title=safe_title, body=safe_body)
